title: Divers Found Perfect Circles on the Seabed. A 5-Inch Fish Made Them
subject: pufferfish

scenes.text: Divers off Japan kept finding perfect circles on the seabed. Nobody knew who made them.
Each one was about two meters across, with ridges that radiate out like a flower.
The first were spotted around 1995. It took until 2011 to catch the artist.
A pufferfish. About ten centimeters long, five inches. A new species nobody had named.
The male builds it alone, over about a week, to impress a female.
She judges his work. A tiny fish carving a masterpiece on the ocean floor.

description:
Divers off Japan kept finding perfect circles on the seabed, and no one knew who made them.
It turned out to be a 5-inch pufferfish, which builds a two-meter sand nest over about a week to impress a female.
Would you notice if a fish out-did your art?
first_comment: The species is the white-spotted pufferfish, and the circles are found off Amami-Oshima Island in Japan. Would you dive there to see one?
